mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hp_task_exec_artifact(exec_id, artifact_key, type, content, rows_count, bytes, cost_ms) VALUES (#{execId}, #{artifactKey}, #{type}, #{content}, #{rowsCount}, #{bytes}, #{costMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = VALUES(type), content = VALUES(content), rows_count = VALUES(rows_count), bytes = VALUES(bytes), cost_ms = VALUES(cost_ms), error_code = NULL, error_msg = NULL

INSERT INTO hp_task_exec_artifact(exec_id, artifact_key, type, error_code, error_msg) VALUES (#{execId}, #{artifactKey}, #{type}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMsg}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = VALUES(type), error_code = VALUES(error_code), error_msg = VALUES(error_msg)
